items.question: Trong câu "A protocol is a set of rules and conventions that devices must follow in order to communicate with one another.", từ "a set of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A protocol is a set of rules and conventions that devices must follow in order to communicate with one another.", what does "a set of" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: a line of things in order
items.explanation: a set of /ə ˈset əv/ (cụm từ): một tập hợp, một bộ. "A set of rules" = một bộ quy tắc; "set" còn là động từ "đặt, thiết lập".
items.explanationEn: a set of /ə ˈset əv/ (phrase): a group of related things. "A set of rules" is a group of them; "set" is also a verb meaning to put or configure.

items.question: Trong câu "A protocol is a set of rules and conventions that devices must follow in order to communicate with one another.", từ "rule" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A protocol is a set of rules and conventions that devices must follow in order to communicate with one another.", what does "rule" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a statement of what must be done
items.explanation: rule /ruːl/ (danh từ): quy tắc. "Follow the rules" = tuân theo quy tắc; "firewall rule" = quy tắc tường lửa.
items.explanationEn: rule /ruːl/ (noun): a statement of what must be done. "Follow the rules" means obeying them; also "firewall rule".

items.question: Trong câu "A protocol is a set of rules and conventions that devices must follow in order to communicate with one another.", từ "convention" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A protocol is a set of rules and conventions that devices must follow in order to communicate with one another.", what does "convention" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an agreed usual way of doing
items.explanation: convention /kənˈven.ʃən/ (danh từ): quy ước. "Naming convention" = quy ước đặt tên; "convention" còn là hội nghị lớn.
items.explanationEn: convention /kənˈven.ʃən/ (noun): an agreed usual way of doing. "Naming convention" is an agreed way to name things; "convention" can also be a big conference.

items.question: Trong câu "A protocol is a set of rules and conventions that devices must follow in order to communicate with one another.", từ "follow" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A protocol is a set of rules and conventions that devices must follow in order to communicate with one another.", what does "follow" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to obey or act according to
items.explanation: follow /ˈfɒl.əʊ/ (động từ): tuân theo. "Follow rules/instructions" = làm theo quy tắc/hướng dẫn.
items.explanationEn: follow /ˈfɒl.əʊ/ (verb): to obey or act according to. "Follow rules/instructions" means acting as they say.

items.question: Trong câu "A protocol is a set of rules and conventions that devices must follow in order to communicate with one another.", từ "in order to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A protocol is a set of rules and conventions that devices must follow in order to communicate with one another.", what does "in order to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in order to /ɪn ˈɔː.dər tuː/ (cụm từ): để (mà). "In order to + động từ" chỉ mục đích, trang trọng hơn "to"; khác "in order" (theo thứ tự).
items.explanationEn: in order to /ɪn ˈɔː.dər tuː/ (phrase): for the purpose of. "In order to + verb" shows purpose, more formal than "to"; differs from "in order" (in sequence).

items.question: Trong câu "A protocol is a set of rules and conventions that devices must follow in order to communicate with one another.", từ "communicate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A protocol is a set of rules and conventions that devices must follow in order to communicate with one another.", what does "communicate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: communicate /kəˈmjuː.nɪ.keɪt/ (động từ): giao tiếp, trao đổi. "Communicate with" = giao tiếp với; danh từ: communication.
items.explanationEn: communicate /kəˈmjuː.nɪ.keɪt/ (verb): to exchange information. "Communicate with" someone or something; noun: communication.

items.question: Trong câu "A protocol is a set of rules and conventions that devices must follow in order to communicate with one another.", từ "one another" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A protocol is a set of rules and conventions that devices must follow in order to communicate with one another.", what does "one another" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: each of them with the others
items.explanation: one another /ˌwʌn əˈnʌð.ər/ (cụm từ): lẫn nhau. "Communicate with one another" = giao tiếp với nhau; gần nghĩa "each other".
items.explanationEn: one another /ˌwʌn əˈnʌð.ər/ (phrase): each of them with the others. "Communicate with one another" means with each other.

items.question: Trong câu "It is like a shared language — two people must speak the same language to understand each other.", từ "shared" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is like a shared language — two people must speak the same language to understand each other.", what does "shared" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: shared /ʃeəd/ (tính từ): chung. "A shared language/drive" = ngôn ngữ/ổ đĩa chung; động từ: share.
items.explanationEn: shared /ʃeəd/ (adjective): used or had by several. "A shared language/drive" is common to several; verb: share.

items.question: Trong câu "It is like a shared language — two people must speak the same language to understand each other.", từ "each other" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is like a shared language — two people must speak the same language to understand each other.", what does "each other" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: each other /ˌiːtʃ ˈʌð.ər/ (cụm từ): nhau, lẫn nhau. "Understand each other" = hiểu nhau; dùng khi hai (hoặc nhiều) bên tác động qua lại.
items.explanationEn: each other /ˌiːtʃ ˈʌð.ər/ (phrase): each one to the other. "Understand each other" describes a two-way action between people or things.

items.question: Trong câu "TCP/IP is the foundational protocol suite of the Internet, consisting of 4 layers:", từ "foundational" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "TCP/IP is the foundational protocol suite of the Internet, consisting of 4 layers:", what does "foundational" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: foundational /faʊnˈdeɪ.ʃən.əl/ (tính từ): nền tảng. "Foundational protocol suite" = bộ giao thức nền tảng; danh từ: foundation.
items.explanationEn: foundational /faʊnˈdeɪ.ʃən.əl/ (adjective): forming the base for others. "Foundational protocol suite" is the base set; noun: foundation.

items.question: Trong câu "TCP/IP is the foundational protocol suite of the Internet, consisting of 4 layers:", từ "suite" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "TCP/IP is the foundational protocol suite of the Internet, consisting of 4 layers:", what does "suite" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a set of rooms in a hotel
a piece of music in parts
a set of things used together
items.explanation: suite /swiːt/ (danh từ): bộ (phần mềm, giao thức). "Protocol suite", "test suite" = bộ giao thức, bộ kiểm thử; phát âm /swiːt/ như "sweet", đừng nhầm "suit".
items.explanationEn: suite /swiːt/ (noun): a set of things used together. "Protocol suite", "test suite"; it sounds like "sweet", not like "suit".

items.question: Trong câu "TCP/IP is the foundational protocol suite of the Internet, consisting of 4 layers:", từ "consist of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "TCP/IP is the foundational protocol suite of the Internet, consisting of 4 layers:", what does "consist of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: consist of /kənˈsɪst əv/ (cụm từ): gồm có. "Consist of 4 layers" = gồm 4 tầng; không dùng ở dạng bị động (không nói "is consisted of").
items.explanationEn: consist of /kənˈsɪst əv/ (phrase): to be made up of. "Consist of 4 layers" means made up of four; never use it in the passive.

items.question: Trong câu "TCP/IP is the foundational protocol suite of the Internet, consisting of 4 layers:", từ "layer" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "TCP/IP is the foundational protocol suite of the Internet, consisting of 4 layers:", what does "layer" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: one level in a stacked design
items.explanation: layer /ˈleɪ.ər/ (danh từ): tầng, lớp. "Network layers" = các tầng mạng; "application layer" = tầng ứng dụng.
items.explanationEn: layer /ˈleɪ.ər/ (noun): one level in a stacked design. "Network layers" are stacked levels; e.g. "application layer".

items.question: Trong câu "TCP guarantees that data arrives completely and in the correct order:", từ "guarantee" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "TCP guarantees that data arrives completely and in the correct order:", what does "guarantee" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to agree to pay a debt
to promise that something will happen
items.explanation: guarantee /ˌɡær.ənˈtiː/ (động từ): đảm bảo. "Guarantee that..." = đảm bảo rằng...; danh từ "guarantee" = sự đảm bảo, bảo hành.
items.explanationEn: guarantee /ˌɡær.ənˈtiː/ (verb): to promise that something will happen. "Guarantee that..." promises a result; the noun also means a warranty.

items.question: Trong câu "TCP guarantees that data arrives completely and in the correct order:", từ "arrive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "TCP guarantees that data arrives completely and in the correct order:", what does "arrive" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to set off on a trip
items.explanation: arrive /əˈraɪv/ (động từ): đến nơi. "Data arrives" = dữ liệu đến nơi; "arrive at/in" + địa điểm; danh từ: arrival.
items.explanationEn: arrive /əˈraɪv/ (verb): to reach a destination. "Data arrives" means it reaches the other side; use "arrive at/in"; noun: arrival.

items.question: Trong câu "TCP guarantees that data arrives completely and in the correct order:", từ "completely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "TCP guarantees that data arrives completely and in the correct order:", what does "completely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: completely /kəmˈpliːt.li/ (trạng từ): đầy đủ, trọn vẹn. "Arrive completely" = đến đầy đủ không thiếu phần nào; tính từ: complete.
items.explanationEn: completely /kəmˈpliːt.li/ (adverb): with no part missing. "Arrive completely" means every part gets there; adjective: complete.

items.question: Trong câu "Establishes a connection first (3-way handshake).", từ "establish" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Establishes a connection first (3-way handshake).", what does "establish" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: establish /ɪˈstæb.lɪʃ/ (động từ): thiết lập. "Establish a connection" = thiết lập kết nối; tính từ: established (đã thiết lập).
items.explanationEn: establish /ɪˈstæb.lɪʃ/ (verb): to set up or create. "Establish a connection" means setting one up; adjective: established.

items.question: Trong câu "Establishes a connection first (3-way handshake).", từ "connection" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Establishes a connection first (3-way handshake).", what does "connection" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a link that lets data flow
items.explanation: connection /kəˈnek.ʃən/ (danh từ): kết nối. "Establish/close a connection" = mở/đóng kết nối; động từ: connect.
items.explanationEn: connection /kəˈnek.ʃən/ (noun): a link that lets data flow. "Establish/close a connection" opens or ends a link; verb: connect.

items.question: Trong câu "Establishes a connection first (3-way handshake).", từ "handshake" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Establishes a connection first (3-way handshake).", what does "handshake" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: handshake /ˈhænd.ʃeɪk/ (danh từ): bắt tay (trao đổi mở đầu). "3-way handshake" = bắt tay ba bước, nghĩa bóng từ cái bắt tay giữa người với người.
items.explanationEn: handshake /ˈhænd.ʃeɪk/ (noun): an opening exchange between devices. "3-way handshake" borrows the image of people shaking hands.

items.question: Trong câu "Checks for errors and retransmits if a packet is lost.", từ "check for" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Checks for errors and retransmits if a packet is lost.", what does "check for" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to leave bags at a desk
to look to see if there is
items.explanation: check for /ˈtʃek fɔːr/ (cụm từ): kiểm tra xem có. "Check for errors/updates" = kiểm tra lỗi/bản cập nhật.
items.explanationEn: check for /ˈtʃek fɔːr/ (phrase): to look to see if there is. "Check for errors/updates" means looking to see if any exist.

items.question: Trong câu "Checks for errors and retransmits if a packet is lost.", từ "error" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Checks for errors and retransmits if a packet is lost.", what does "error" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a fault that makes data wrong
items.explanation: error /ˈer.ər/ (danh từ): lỗi (dữ liệu). "Check for errors" = kiểm tra lỗi; "error message" = thông báo lỗi.
items.explanationEn: error /ˈer.ər/ (noun): a fault that makes data wrong. "Check for errors" means finding faults; "error message" reports one.

items.question: Trong câu "Checks for errors and retransmits if a packet is lost.", từ "retransmit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Checks for errors and retransmits if a packet is lost.", what does "retransmit" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to pass on to someone else
items.explanation: retransmit /ˌriː.trænzˈmɪt/ (động từ): truyền lại. Tiền tố re- = lại; "retransmits if a packet is lost" = gửi lại khi mất gói; danh từ: retransmission.
items.explanationEn: retransmit /ˌriː.trænzˈmɪt/ (verb): to send again. Prefix re- means again; noun: retransmission.

items.question: Trong câu "Checks for errors and retransmits if a packet is lost.", từ "lost" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Checks for errors and retransmits if a packet is lost.", what does "lost" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: lost /lɒst/ (tính từ): bị mất. "A packet is lost" = gói tin bị mất; "packet loss" = hiện tượng mất gói.
items.explanationEn: lost /lɒst/ (adjective): not arrived and gone missing. "A packet is lost" means it never arrives; noun phrase: packet loss.

items.question: Trong câu "Slower than UDP but reliable.", từ "reliable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Slower than UDP but reliable.", what does "reliable" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: able to be trusted to work
items.explanation: reliable /rɪˈlaɪ.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): tin cậy. "Reliable connection" = kết nối tin cậy; danh từ: reliability.
items.explanationEn: reliable /rɪˈlaɪ.ə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be trusted to work. "Reliable connection" works as expected; noun: reliability.

items.question: Trong câu "UDP sends data without requiring acknowledgment:", từ "require" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "UDP sends data without requiring acknowledgment:", what does "require" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: require /rɪˈkwaɪər/ (động từ): đòi hỏi, cần. "Without requiring X" = mà không cần X; danh từ: requirement.
items.explanationEn: require /rɪˈkwaɪər/ (verb): to need or demand. "Without requiring X" means X is not needed; noun: requirement.

items.question: Trong câu "UDP sends data without requiring acknowledgment:", từ "acknowledgment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "UDP sends data without requiring acknowledgment:", what does "acknowledgment" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a reply saying it was received
items.explanation: acknowledgment /əkˈnɒl.ɪdʒ.mənt/ (danh từ): xác nhận đã nhận. "Acknowledgment" (ACK) = tín hiệu xác nhận đã nhận; động từ: acknowledge; Anh-Anh viết acknowledgement.
items.explanationEn: acknowledgment /əkˈnɒl.ɪdʒ.mənt/ (noun): a reply saying it was received. "Acknowledgment" (ACK) confirms receipt; verb: acknowledge; British spelling: acknowledgement.

items.question: Trong câu "Used for: video streaming, online gaming, DNS, VoIP (calls).", từ "streaming" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Used for: video streaming, online gaming, DNS, VoIP (calls).", what does "streaming" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: streaming /ˈstriː.mɪŋ/ (danh từ): phát trực tuyến. "Video streaming" = phát video trực tuyến; động từ: stream.
items.explanationEn: streaming /ˈstriː.mɪŋ/ (noun): playing media as it downloads. "Video streaming" plays while data arrives; verb: stream.

items.question: Trong câu "The protocol for transferring web pages.", từ "transfer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The protocol for transferring web pages.", what does "transfer" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to move from one place to another
to send money to an account
items.explanation: transfer /trænsˈfɜːr/ (động từ): truyền, chuyển. "Transfer web pages/files" = truyền trang web/tệp; "Transfer" có trong tên HTTP và FTP.
items.explanationEn: transfer /trænsˈfɜːr/ (verb): to move from one place to another. "Transfer web pages/files" moves them; it appears in the names HTTP and FTP.

items.question: Trong câu "It works on a Request – Response model:", từ "work on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It works on a Request – Response model:", what does "work on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: work on /ˈwɜːk ɒn/ (cụm từ): hoạt động dựa trên. "It works on a model" = nó hoạt động theo mô hình; "I'm working on it" = tôi đang làm việc đó.
items.explanationEn: work on /ˈwɜːk ɒn/ (phrase): to function using. "It works on a model" means it functions that way; "I'm working on it" means busy with it.

items.question: Trong câu "It works on a Request – Response model:", từ "request" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It works on a Request – Response model:", what does "request" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: request /rɪˈkwest/ (danh từ): yêu cầu. "Send a request" = gửi yêu cầu; cặp đôi với "response".
items.explanationEn: request /rɪˈkwest/ (noun): a message asking for something. "Send a request" asks the server; its pair is "response".

items.question: Trong câu "It works on a Request – Response model:", từ "response" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It works on a Request – Response model:", what does "response" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: response /rɪˈspɒns/ (danh từ): phản hồi. "Request – Response" = yêu cầu – phản hồi; động từ: respond.
items.explanationEn: response /rɪˈspɒns/ (noun): the reply to a request. "Request – Response" is ask-and-reply; verb: respond.

items.question: Trong câu "It works on a Request – Response model:", từ "model" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It works on a Request – Response model:", what does "model" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a pattern describing how it works
items.explanation: model /ˈmɒd.əl/ (danh từ): mô hình. "Request – Response model" = mô hình yêu cầu – phản hồi; "TCP/IP model" = mô hình TCP/IP.
items.explanationEn: model /ˈmɒd.əl/ (noun): a pattern describing how it works. "Request – Response model" describes the pattern; also "TCP/IP model".

items.question: Trong câu "GET: retrieve data.", từ "retrieve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "GET: retrieve data.", what does "retrieve" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to fetch as a dog does
items.explanation: retrieve /rɪˈtriːv/ (động từ): lấy (dữ liệu) về. "Retrieve data" = lấy dữ liệu; danh từ: retrieval.
items.explanationEn: retrieve /rɪˈtriːv/ (verb): to get stored data back. "Retrieve data" means getting it back; noun: retrieval.

items.question: Trong câu "401 Unauthorized: not authenticated.", từ "authenticate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "401 Unauthorized: not authenticated.", what does "authenticate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to prove who a user is
to prove an object is real
items.explanation: authenticate /ɔːˈθen.tɪ.keɪt/ (động từ): xác thực (danh tính). "Not authenticated" = chưa xác thực (chưa đăng nhập); khác "authorize" (cấp quyền).
items.explanationEn: authenticate /ɔːˈθen.tɪ.keɪt/ (verb): to prove who a user is. "Not authenticated" means identity not proven; differs from "authorize" (grant rights).

items.question: Trong câu "403 Forbidden: no permission.", từ "permission" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "403 Forbidden: no permission.", what does "permission" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: permission /pəˈmɪʃ.ən/ (danh từ): quyền (được phép). "No permission" = không có quyền; động từ: permit.
items.explanationEn: permission /pəˈmɪʃ.ən/ (noun): the right to do something. "No permission" means not allowed; verb: permit.

items.question: Trong câu "Data is encrypted before transmission, protecting it from eavesdropping.", từ "encrypt" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Data is encrypted before transmission, protecting it from eavesdropping.", what does "encrypt" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to turn code back to text
items.explanation: encrypt /ɪnˈkrɪpt/ (động từ): mã hóa. "Data is encrypted" = dữ liệu được mã hóa; danh từ: encryption; trái nghĩa: decrypt.
items.explanationEn: encrypt /ɪnˈkrɪpt/ (verb): to turn into secret code. "Data is encrypted" is scrambled for safety; noun: encryption; opposite: decrypt.

items.question: Trong câu "Data is encrypted before transmission, protecting it from eavesdropping.", từ "transmission" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Data is encrypted before transmission, protecting it from eavesdropping.", what does "transmission" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: transmission /trænzˈmɪʃ.ən/ (danh từ): sự truyền (dữ liệu). "Before transmission" = trước khi truyền; động từ: transmit.
items.explanationEn: transmission /trænzˈmɪʃ.ən/ (noun): the sending of data. "Before transmission" means before sending; verb: transmit.

items.question: Trong câu "Data is encrypted before transmission, protecting it from eavesdropping.", từ "protect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Data is encrypted before transmission, protecting it from eavesdropping.", what does "protect" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: protect /prəˈtekt/ (động từ): bảo vệ. "Protect X from Y" = bảo vệ X khỏi Y; danh từ: protection.
items.explanationEn: protect /prəˈtekt/ (verb): to keep safe from harm. "Protect X from Y" keeps X safe from Y; noun: protection.

items.question: Trong câu "Data is encrypted before transmission, protecting it from eavesdropping.", từ "eavesdrop" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Data is encrypted before transmission, protecting it from eavesdropping.", what does "eavesdrop" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: eavesdrop /ˈiːvz.drɒp/ (động từ): nghe lén. "Protect from eavesdropping" = chống nghe lén; "eavesdrop on" + đối tượng.
items.explanationEn: eavesdrop /ˈiːvz.drɒp/ (verb): to secretly listen in. "Protect from eavesdropping" stops secret listening; use "eavesdrop on" someone.

items.question: Trong câu "Recognizable by the padlock icon 🔒 in the browser.", từ "recognizable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Recognizable by the padlock icon 🔒 in the browser.", what does "recognizable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: recognizable /ˈrek.əɡ.naɪ.zə.bəl/ (tính từ): dễ nhận ra. "Recognizable by X" = nhận ra nhờ X; động từ: recognize; Anh-Anh: recognisable.
items.explanationEn: recognizable /ˈrek.əɡ.naɪ.zə.bəl/ (adjective): easy to identify. "Recognizable by X" means X helps you spot it; verb: recognize; British: recognisable.

items.question: Trong câu "Recognizable by the padlock icon 🔒 in the browser.", từ "padlock" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Recognizable by the padlock icon 🔒 in the browser.", what does "padlock" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a tool that opens a lock
a lock with a curved bar
items.explanation: padlock /ˈpæd.lɒk/ (danh từ): ổ khóa móc. "Padlock icon" = biểu tượng ổ khóa trên thanh địa chỉ, cho biết trang dùng HTTPS.
items.explanationEn: padlock /ˈpæd.lɒk/ (noun): a lock with a curved bar. The "padlock icon" in the address bar shows HTTPS is used.

items.question: Trong câu "Recognizable by the padlock icon 🔒 in the browser.", từ "icon" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Recognizable by the padlock icon 🔒 in the browser.", what does "icon" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a small picture on a screen
items.explanation: icon /ˈaɪ.kɒn/ (danh từ): biểu tượng (trên màn hình). "Click the icon" = nhấn vào biểu tượng; "icon" còn chỉ người nổi tiếng mang tính biểu tượng.
items.explanationEn: icon /ˈaɪ.kɒn/ (noun): a small picture on a screen. "Click the icon" means the small picture; it can also mean a famous figure.

items.question: Trong câu "Required for any website handling sensitive information.", từ "handle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Required for any website handling sensitive information.", what does "handle" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: the part you hold on a door
items.explanation: handle /ˈhæn.dəl/ (động từ): xử lý. "Websites handling sensitive information" = trang web xử lý thông tin nhạy cảm.
items.explanationEn: handle /ˈhæn.dəl/ (verb): to deal with or manage. "Websites handling sensitive information" are ones that process such data.

items.question: Trong câu "Required for any website handling sensitive information.", từ "sensitive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Required for any website handling sensitive information.", what does "sensitive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sensitive /ˈsen.sɪ.tɪv/ (tính từ): nhạy cảm, cần bảo mật. "Sensitive information/data" = thông tin/dữ liệu nhạy cảm; "case-sensitive" = phân biệt hoa thường.
items.explanationEn: sensitive /ˈsen.sɪ.tɪv/ (adjective): private and needing protection. "Sensitive information/data" must be protected; "case-sensitive" means capitals matter.

items.question: Trong câu "Required for any website handling sensitive information.", từ "information" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Required for any website handling sensitive information.", what does "information" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: information /ˌɪn.fəˈmeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): thông tin. "Information" là danh từ không đếm được: không nói "an information", mà "a piece of information".
items.explanationEn: information /ˌɪn.fəˈmeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): facts or data about something. "Information" is uncountable: say "a piece of information", not "an information".

items.question: Trong câu "DNS is the system that converts easy-to-remember domain names into IP addresses:", từ "system" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DNS is the system that converts easy-to-remember domain names into IP addresses:", what does "system" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a set of parts working together
items.explanation: system /ˈsɪs.təm/ (danh từ): hệ thống. "Domain Name System" = hệ thống tên miền; tính từ: systematic (có hệ thống).
items.explanationEn: system /ˈsɪs.təm/ (noun): a set of parts working together. "Domain Name System" is a set of working parts; adjective: systematic.

items.question: Trong câu "DNS is the system that converts easy-to-remember domain names into IP addresses:", từ "convert" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DNS is the system that converts easy-to-remember domain names into IP addresses:", what does "convert" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: convert /kənˈvɜːt/ (động từ): chuyển đổi. "Convert A into B" = chuyển A thành B; DNS chuyển tên miền thành địa chỉ IP.
items.explanationEn: convert /kənˈvɜːt/ (verb): to change into another form. "Convert A into B" changes A into B; DNS turns names into IP addresses.

items.question: Trong câu "DNS is the system that converts easy-to-remember domain names into IP addresses:", từ "easy-to-remember" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DNS is the system that converts easy-to-remember domain names into IP addresses:", what does "easy-to-remember" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: easy-to-remember /ˌiː.zi tə rɪˈmem.bər/ (tính từ): dễ nhớ. Tính từ ghép có gạch nối khi đứng trước danh từ: easy-to-remember names, easy-to-use tools.
items.explanationEn: easy-to-remember /ˌiː.zi tə rɪˈmem.bər/ (adjective): simple to keep in mind. Hyphenate compound adjectives before a noun: easy-to-remember names, easy-to-use tools.

items.question: Trong câu "DNS is the system that converts easy-to-remember domain names into IP addresses:", từ "domain" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DNS is the system that converts easy-to-remember domain names into IP addresses:", what does "domain" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a website's name on the Internet
items.explanation: domain /dəˈmeɪn/ (danh từ): tên miền. "Domain name" = tên miền (google.com); "domain" còn là lĩnh vực chuyên môn (domain knowledge).
items.explanationEn: domain /dəˈmeɪn/ (noun): a website's name on the Internet. "Domain name" is like google.com; "domain" also means a field (domain knowledge).

items.question: Trong câu "You type google.com.", từ "type" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You type google.com.", what does "type" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: type /taɪp/ (động từ): gõ (bàn phím). "Type a URL" = gõ địa chỉ; danh từ "type" = loại (data type).
items.explanationEn: type /taɪp/ (verb): to write using a keyboard. "Type a URL" means entering it by keyboard; the noun means a kind (data type).

items.question: Trong câu "The browser checks its local DNS cache.", từ "browser" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The browser checks its local DNS cache.", what does "browser" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: browser /ˈbraʊ.zər/ (danh từ): trình duyệt. "Web browser" = trình duyệt web; động từ: browse.
items.explanationEn: browser /ˈbraʊ.zər/ (noun): a program for viewing websites. "Web browser" opens websites; verb: browse.

items.question: Trong câu "The browser checks its local DNS cache.", từ "local" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The browser checks its local DNS cache.", what does "local" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: of a nearby town or area
items.explanation: local /ˈləʊ.kəl/ (tính từ): cục bộ, trên máy. "Local cache/file" = bộ đệm/tệp trên máy mình; trái nghĩa: remote.
items.explanationEn: local /ˈləʊ.kəl/ (adjective): stored on your own device. "Local cache/file" lives on your device; opposite: remote.

items.question: Trong câu "The browser checks its local DNS cache.", từ "cache" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The browser checks its local DNS cache.", what does "cache" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a store of recent data for speed
items.explanation: cache /kæʃ/ (danh từ): bộ nhớ đệm. "DNS cache" = bộ đệm DNS; phát âm /kæʃ/ giống "cash" (tiền mặt).
items.explanationEn: cache /kæʃ/ (noun): a store of recent data for speed. "DNS cache" stores recent lookups; it sounds exactly like "cash".

items.question: Trong câu "If not found → it asks the ISP's DNS server.", từ "server" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If not found → it asks the ISP's DNS server.", what does "server" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: server /ˈsɜː.vər/ (danh từ): máy chủ. "DNS server" = máy chủ DNS; cặp đôi với "client" (máy khách).
items.explanationEn: server /ˈsɜː.vər/ (noun): a computer that answers requests. "DNS server" answers lookups; its pair is "client".

items.question: Trong câu "The browser connects to that IP.", từ "connect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The browser connects to that IP.", what does "connect" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to get on well with someone
items.explanation: connect /kəˈnekt/ (động từ): kết nối. "Connect to an IP/server" = kết nối tới IP/máy chủ; danh từ: connection.
items.explanationEn: connect /kəˈnekt/ (verb): to join to something. "Connect to an IP/server" opens a link to it; noun: connection.

items.question: Trong câu "Protocol = the shared rules of communication between devices.", từ "communication" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Protocol = the shared rules of communication between devices.", what does "communication" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: communication /kəˌmjuː.nɪˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự giao tiếp, trao đổi. "Rules of communication" = quy tắc giao tiếp; động từ: communicate.
items.explanationEn: communication /kəˌmjuː.nɪˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): the exchange of information. "Rules of communication" govern exchanging data; verb: communicate.

items.question: Trong câu "TCP: reliable, guarantees order → used for web, email.", từ "reliable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "TCP: reliable, guarantees order → used for web, email.", what does "reliable" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: able to be trusted to work
items.explanation: reliable /rɪˈlaɪ.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): tin cậy. "TCP is reliable" = TCP tin cậy; trái nghĩa: unreliable.
items.explanationEn: reliable /rɪˈlaɪ.ə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be trusted to work. "TCP is reliable" means data arrives as sent; opposite: unreliable.

items.question: Trong câu "UDP: fast, no guarantees → used for video, gaming.", từ "guarantee" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "UDP: fast, no guarantees → used for video, gaming.", what does "guarantee" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a promise that something will happen
items.explanation: guarantee /ˌɡær.ənˈtiː/ (danh từ): sự đảm bảo. "No guarantees" = không có đảm bảo gì; động từ cùng dạng: guarantee.
items.explanationEn: guarantee /ˌɡær.ənˈtiː/ (noun): a promise that something will happen. "No guarantees" means nothing is promised; the verb has the same form.

items.question: Trong câu "HTTP/HTTPS: the protocols of the web.", từ "protocol" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "HTTP/HTTPS: the protocols of the web.", what does "protocol" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a set of rules for communication
items.explanation: protocol /ˈprəʊ.tə.kɒl/ (danh từ): giao thức. "The protocols of the web" = các giao thức của web (HTTP/HTTPS).
items.explanationEn: protocol /ˈprəʊ.tə.kɒl/ (noun): a set of rules for communication. "The protocols of the web" are HTTP and HTTPS.

items.question: Trong câu "HTTPS encrypts data.", từ "encrypt" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "HTTPS encrypts data.", what does "encrypt" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to turn code back into text
items.explanation: encrypt /ɪnˈkrɪpt/ (động từ): mã hóa. "HTTPS encrypts data" = HTTPS mã hóa dữ liệu; danh từ: encryption.
items.explanationEn: encrypt /ɪnˈkrɪpt/ (verb): to turn into secret code. "HTTPS encrypts data" scrambles it for safety; noun: encryption.
